device.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

problem.cause: Awkward selected-row counts were not divisible by the requested 1024-row chunk and silently fell back to a low-parallelism direct gradient GEMM. GPU utilization reported 100 percent while board power remained near 126 W.

fix.description: Reduce the 8192-row regular prefix as batched partial GEMMs and reduce only the 91-row tail directly.

power_observation.scope: Manual device samples during bounded full experiment phases; not a percentile distribution. Replay generation and phase transitions remain lower-power.

quality_boundary.interpretation: The optimized one-step DAgger fit is fast but its full coarse replacement degrades recurrent quality. More optimizer updates are not justified without a recurrent commutator or TBPTT objective.
